programmes.evidence: The official research-intensive Engineering PhD page explicitly lists Industrial and Systems Engineering among its concentrations. The 60-credit programme requires 12 credits of coursework, 48 thesis credits, oral defence and at least two accepted or published Q1/Q2 journal papers. It states the Engineering PhD was first offered in Fall 2011.
limitations: One broad Engineering doctorate with an Industrial and Systems Engineering concentration, not a separate degree for each concentration. The programme page does not explicitly allocate each concentration to a department; the existing independently verified Mechanical and Industrial Engineering department is linked as the relevant unit, without assigning exclusive programme administration.

branches.conclusion: The complete 51-entry central graduate table and full Business Administration PhD overview were read. The business doctorate lists Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Management and Marketing. These broad disciplines do not independently establish Operations or supply-chain doctoral provision; detailed research-field inventory remains unresolved.

The college graduate overview lists one PhD with twelve major fields, including Industrial and Systems Engineering and Engineering Management. The entire research-intensive PhD page explicitly verifies the ISE concentration and original thesis requirements. Engineering Management and the other concentrations have not been examined for additional substantive Operations research scope; conventional versus research-intensive route overlap is not separately enumerated.
